title: Reserves of Nassau | Cape Gazette
text: 17318 King Philip Way #40, Lewes, DE 19958– Welcome to this end unit townhome featuring 4 bedrooms, 3.5 bathrooms, and a first-floor primary suite for easy, convenient living! Located east of Route 1 in the Reserves of Nassau with a community pool, this home offers the perfect blend of comfort, style, and coastal charm. Enjoy the outdoors from your private screened-in porch, and take advantage of the unfinished walkout basement—a versatile space with tons of potential for additional living area, entertainment space, or storage. The home also includes an attached garage, offering added convenience and secure parking. With its prime location just minutes from Lewes Beach and the popular bike trail, this home provides easy access to all the best that coastal Delaware has to offer—whether you're exploring nature, dining out, or simply relaxing by the shore. Perfect as a full-time residence, beach retreat, or investment property—this one checks all the boxes!
